back:
List-initialization (also called uniform initialization or brace initialization) uses curly braces. If you see {}, you are list-initializing.

Direct-list-initialization: int width{ 5 };   (preferred)
Copy-list-initialization:   int height = { 6 };   (rarely used)

It works in almost all cases, is unambiguous, can take a list of values, and disallows narrowing conversions.
